# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# is_adventure_eligible
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
# INCOMING CALLS: adventure.0001 (trigger block), adventure.0004 (trigger block)
# OUTGOING CALLS: (none — pure condition check)
# -------------------------------------------------------------------
is_adventure_eligible = {
	is_adult = yes
	is_alive = yes
	is_imprisoned = no
	NOT = { has_trait = incapable }
	NOT = { has_character_flag = planning_adventure }
}
